name: hackathon-project-delivery
description: A bilingual Codex workflow plugin for turning UCWS and general hackathon ideas into shipped apps, GitHub repositories, public demos, and copy-ready submission packages.

interface.shortDescription: Ship hackathon apps with GitHub, demos, and proof.
interface.longDescription: A bilingual Codex workflow for researching hackathon requirements, shaping a product, building a working app, publishing to GitHub, deploying a public demo, preparing official submission fields, and verifying final readiness for UCWS and future hackathons. Version 0.2 adds finer delivery gates, evidence matrices, and more granular README guidance.
defaultPrompt: Use $hackathon-project-delivery to turn this hackathon idea into a shipped submission.
Use $hackathon-project-delivery to audit my repo, demo link, and submission fields.
Use $hackathon-project-delivery for a UCWS-ready project package.
